title: "Hands-on: File and Resource Management"
description: "Seminar · Build a test folder with clear file names, move files from the test phone to the PC, and free space safely before a test."
seminar: 6
ilos: [A2, C1]

---

No new ideas today: you manage the files and the resources of a test with
what you learned in Lecture 6. Do each activity alone, then open "Check your
result". Every question on this page has its answer: try first, then check.

## Recall

- The file system keeps files in folders; a path goes one folder deeper at
  every `\` (Android: `/`); the extension names the kind of file.
- A phone on USB needs the **file transfer** mode (iPhone: Trust this
  computer).
- The device check: 2 GB free, battery above 50 %, only the game open, Do not
  disturb, the OS version in the report.

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · Recall"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="1 GB|.exe"}
Which extension has a save file?
:   .sav

    Why: the extension names the kind of file.

How much free storage does the device check ask for?
:   at least 2 GB

    Why: the game needs room during the test.

The phone charges, but the PC shows no files. What do you change?
:   the USB mode to file transfer

    Why: "charging only" does not share the files.
:::
:::

## Activity 1 · Files that anyone can find: folders and names

- One folder per **game build**, with subfolders **builds**, **screenshots**,
  **reports**.
- A good name says **what**, **which version or device**, **when**; no
  spaces; the date first as year-month-day.
- `PocketQuest_1.2_android.apk` · `2026-11-12_P5_level3.png` ·
  `2026-11-12_P5_report.docx`.
- Date first: `2026-10-13_…` comes before `2026-11-12_…`, so files sort in
  time order.

![A test folder with clear names.](images/test-folder.png){width=92%}

{{< sim file="sims/name-checker.html" poster="sims/name-checker.png" title="Name Checker: file names for a test" height="460" >}}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
`final.apk`, `final_new.apk` and `IMG_4821.png` say nothing.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Activity 1 · Build the test folder · 12 min"}
In Documents, make `Tests\PocketQuest_1.2\builds`, `screenshots`,
`reports`. Do the three tasks of **Name Checker**, and make an empty text
file in `reports` with the third name.

*Your product:* a folder with three subfolders and one named file.

::: {.check}
A good folder: `Documents\Tests\PocketQuest_1.2` with `builds`,
`screenshots` and `reports`, and in `reports` a file like
`2026-11-12_P5_report.txt`: date first (year-month-day), the device, what it
is, no spaces.
:::
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · Names"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="game final new.apk|P5.png"}
The best name for the Android build of version 1.2?
:   PocketQuest_1.2_android.apk

    Why: It says what, which version and which platform, without spaces.

The best name for a screenshot of level 3 on P5, 12 November 2026?
:   2026-11-12_P5_level3.png

    Why: The date first, then the device and what it shows.

Why does the date come first, as year-month-day?
:   the files sort in time order

    Why: Year-month-day sorts the files in time order.

What is wrong with IMG_4821.png?
:   it says nothing about the test

    Why: A camera name tells nothing about the test.
:::
:::

## Activity 2 · Move files between the test phone and the PC

- **USB cable:** set the USB mode to **file transfer** (iPhone: Trust this
  computer), then copy in File Explorer. Fast, no Internet.
- **Cloud:** upload on the phone, download on the PC. No cable, but it uses
  the network.
- Android keeps screenshots in `Pictures\Screenshots` and photos in `DCIM`.
- A 300 MB bug video: seconds by USB; minutes and 300 MB of mobile data by
  cloud.
- **Copy** first, check on the PC, then delete from the phone.

![USB or cloud.](images/phone-pc.png){width=90%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Do not move the only copy: copy, check, then delete.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Activity 2 · From your phone to the folder · 10 min"}
Take a screenshot on your phone. Copy it to
`Tests\PocketQuest_1.2\screenshots` (USB or cloud), and rename it with the
date, your phone and what it shows.

*Your product:* one renamed screenshot in the right folder.

::: {.check}
A good result: `Tests\PocketQuest_1.2\screenshots\2026-11-12_A35_home.png`
(today's date, your phone, what it shows). By USB the phone must be in file
transfer mode; the copy stays on the phone until you check it on the PC.
:::
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · Moving files"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="FAT32|the PC has no Wi-Fi"}
The PC shows no files of the phone. What do you change?
:   the USB mode to file transfer

    Why: "Charging only" does not share the files.

Which way is faster for a 300 MB video?
:   the USB cable

    Why: A cable copies it in seconds, without the network.

Where are screenshots on an Android phone?
:   Pictures\\Screenshots

    Why: Android keeps screenshots in Pictures\\Screenshots.

What do you do before you delete the files from the phone?
:   check that the copies are on the PC

    Why: Never delete the only copy.
:::
:::

## Activity 3 · Free space safely

The device check needs at least 2 GB free. Clearing an app's **cache**
frees space and keeps its logins and progress; clearing its **storage**
(data) deletes them.

![The device check.](images/device-check.png){width=86%}

::: {.callout-note title="Activity 3 · Two caches · 8 min"}
1. Write the free space of your phone (Settings › Storage).
2. Find two apps with a big cache (Android: Apps › an app › Storage; iPhone:
   iPhone Storage shows "Documents & Data" only).
3. Clear the cache of one of them (Android). Write the free space again.

*Your product:* the free space before and after, and the app you chose.

::: {.check}
A good answer: "Before 9.4 GB free; I cleared the cache of the browser
(0.6 GB); after 10.0 GB free." The app keeps its login. On an iPhone there
is no Clear cache button: a good answer says so and names the app with the
biggest "Documents & Data".
:::
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 4 · Free space"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="Clear storage|format the phone"}
Which button frees space and keeps the progress?
:   Clear cache

    Why: the cache holds only temporary files.

A phone has 1.6 GB free and clears 0.6 GB of caches. Is it ready for the test?
:   yes, 2.2 GB is more than 2 GB

    Why: 1.6 + 0.6 = 2.2 GB.

What does Clear storage delete?
:   the logins and the progress too

    Why: the storage holds the app's data.
:::
:::

## Game challenge: Test Day at Byte Bay {.challenge}

Work alone. Use every activity of today.

Rami prepares phone **P5** to test *Pocket Quest 1.2* for 40 minutes. P5 has
**1.1 GB** free (the test needs 2 GB), the battery shows **34 %**, and **9
apps** are open. The PC sees no files when P5 is connected. He must name the
screenshot of level 3 of **12 November 2026**, and stop calls.

{{< sim file="sims/test-day.html" poster="sims/test-day.png" title="Test Day: prepare the phone and the files" kind="game" height="600" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 5 · Rami's phone"}
P5: 1.1 GB free, battery 34 %, 9 apps open. Choose the right step.

::: {.match extra="buy a new phone|test now"}
The storage?
:   delete old videos and clear caches

    Why: It frees space and keeps the progress.

The battery?
:   charge above 50 % first

    Why: Below 50 % the phone may save power and slow down.

Calls during the test?
:   turn on Do not disturb

    Why: Do not disturb keeps calls from stopping the test.
:::
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 6 · Rami's files (harder)"}
Rami copies 40 screenshots and a 300 MB video from P5 to the PC. Choose the
right answer.

::: {.match extra="IMG_0001.png|by Bluetooth"}
The PC shows nothing. Why?
:   the phone is set to charging only

    Why: The USB mode must be file transfer.

Which name for the level 3 screenshot of 12 November 2026?
:   2026-11-12_P5_level3.png

    Why: Date first, the device, what it shows.

How does he send the 300 MB video fastest?
:   by USB cable

    Why: A cable is fastest for a big file.
:::
:::

## Wrap-up {.summary}

- You can build a test folder and give files names with the date, the device and what they show.
- You can move files from a phone to the PC by USB or the cloud: copy, check, then delete.
- You can free space safely before a test.
